data.development: sessions starting from 2020-04-01 (end of the burn-in) and before 2021-10-01
data.folds: four expanding-window folds with a purge gap (Task 2 protocol), used for every choice
data.final training: all development sessions that ended before 2021-10-01, so every label was known before the test
data.test: sessions starting from 2021-10-01, scored once with the frozen choices

target.positive: is_Abnormal = 1: end_cause is one of the 13 fault / failure causes
target.negative: is_Abnormal = 0: 'Charging ends normally' or 'User stops charging'

preprocessing.categories: location, district: ordinal codes learned on the training window; an unseen category is treated as missing
preprocessing.numeric features: used as they are: no scaling and no log transform, since the trees only use the order of the values
preprocessing.missing values: kept as missing; the model sends them to the better side of each split, so nothing is imputed
preprocessing.class imbalance: no resampling and no class weights
preprocessing.fitted on: every learned step is fitted on the training window only (learned-operations ledger, Task 1)

threshold.criterion: alert rate 10% of pooled out-of-fold predictions

calibration.reason: No calibrator is fitted: the 10% criterion uses the scores only as a ranking, which calibration would not change; the reliability check (Brier 0.1032, largest band gap 0.015) decides how far the scores can be read as probabilities.
